title: Water Supply & Wastewater Treatment Project References
summary: Tongyang has been deeply involved in water supply and wastewater treatment EPC projects, supporting engineering coordination and industrial equipment supply
body:
Water Supply & Wastewater Treatment Projects

TONGYANG participates in water infrastructure and environmental engineering projects through equipment manufacturing, project-specific supply and engineering coordination in cooperation with EPC contractors and engineering partners.

Our project references cover municipal water supply, raw-water intake infrastructure, wastewater treatment and industrial zero liquid discharge (ZLD) applications.

01. Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source Project

Location: Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, China
Project Type: Emergency Water Supply Infrastructure

Project Overview

The Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source Project involved the development of alternative raw-water supply infrastructure to support regional water security and improve the reliability of municipal water supply systems.

The project covered emergency raw-water intake arrangements, pumping facilities, water transmission infrastructure and associated supporting works. It was intended to improve the flexibility of regional water supply operations under emergency conditions.

Main Scope of Works: Emergency raw-water intake, pumping facilities, water transmission systems and associated infrastructure.

02. Dafeng Tongyu River Intake Upgrade and Enhanced Pretreatment Project

Location: Dafeng District, Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, China
Project Type: Municipal Water Supply and Pretreatment
Project Capacity: Approximately 250,000 m³/day

Project Overview

The Dafeng Tongyu River Intake Upgrade and Enhanced Pretreatment Project was undertaken to improve raw-water intake facilities and strengthen pretreatment capabilities for the regional drinking water supply network.

The project included improvements to water intake infrastructure, pumping and transmission facilities, and enhanced pretreatment systems. These upgrades were intended to strengthen raw-water quality management and improve the operational reliability of municipal water treatment facilities.

Main Scope of Works: Raw-water intake upgrading, enhanced pretreatment facilities, pumping stations, transmission infrastructure and supporting utilities.

03. Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant

Location: Tianfu New Area, Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China
Project Type: Municipal Wastewater Treatment
Project Capacity: Approximately 180,000 m³/day

Project Overview

The Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant is a major urban environmental infrastructure project designed to provide municipal wastewater treatment services while improving land utilization.

The project incorporates underground wastewater treatment facilities with biological treatment, sedimentation, filtration, sludge handling and associated mechanical systems.

By integrating wastewater treatment facilities below ground, the project supports urban environmental management and allows more efficient use of surface land in a developing metropolitan area.

Main Scope of Works: Underground wastewater treatment facilities, biological treatment systems, sludge management, mechanical equipment and associated infrastructure.

04. Huaneng Zhengning Mine-Water Advanced Treatment and Zero Liquid Discharge Project

Location: Zhengning County, Gansu Province, China
Project Type: Industrial Wastewater Treatment and Zero Liquid Discharge

Project Overview

The Huaneng Zhengning Mine-Water Advanced Treatment and Zero Liquid Discharge Project forms part of industrial water conservation and environmental protection initiatives associated with regional energy development.

The project involves advanced mine-water treatment, hardness removal, wastewater concentration and zero liquid discharge technologies. Evaporation and crystallization processes support the treatment of concentrated wastewater streams and improve industrial water reuse.

The project highlights the integration of advanced water treatment technologies with industrial process equipment to reduce wastewater discharge and support sustainable water resource management.

Main Scope of Works: Mine-water advanced treatment, water purification, wastewater concentration, evaporation, crystallization and supporting process facilities.

TONGYANG Equipment Manufacturing & Engineering Support

TONGYANG provides customized industrial equipment manufacturing and engineering coordination services for water supply, wastewater treatment and environmental infrastructure projects.

Our relevant equipment capabilities include:

  • Industrial storage tanks and pressure vessels

  • Shell and tube heat exchangers

  • Evaporation and crystallization equipment

  • Industrial separators and process vessels

  • Skid-mounted equipment packages

  • Manufacturing inspection and technical documentation

We cooperate with EPC contractors, engineering companies and project owners to support equipment manufacturing, procurement coordination and project-specific technical requirements.
